non_us_global_derivatives.eligibility: Eligible customers in supported regions outside the United States
non_us_global_derivatives.scope: Any cross-margined derivative position, including positions settled in a different currency such as USDC

risk_controls.rebalancing: If one settlement-currency equity becomes negative while the account remains solvent, Deribit may use positive-equity currencies to buy the negative-equity currency. This is separate from liquidation.
risk_controls.withdrawal_restriction: Initial margin and negative equity reduce withdrawable collateral.

us_prime_global_derivatives.availability: Eligible U.S. institutional Coinbase Prime clients
us_prime_global_derivatives.collateral_held: CFM secured customer account under CFTC Rule 30.7, delegated to Deribit
us_prime_global_derivatives.interpretation: Current public US Prime documentation does not list XRP as eligible collateral, even though CFTC Letter 26-17 creates a conditional no-action pathway for customer-owned digital commodities including XRP.

cftc_letter_26_17.pathway: Conditional staff no-action relief for CFM to accept customer-owned digital commodities and payment stablecoins as margin and post them with Coinbase Bermuda Limited for specified 30.7 customer obligations on Deribit, subject to right-of-reuse, custody, disclosure and risk controls.
cftc_letter_26_17.digital_commodity_interpretation: The letter references the March 2026 SEC-CFTC interpretation, which explicitly lists XRP as an example of a digital commodity.
cftc_letter_26_17.custody_condition: Deribit maintains assets equal to 100% of net liquidating equity for the relevant 30.7 customer accounts at Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC.
cftc_letter_26_17.cap_condition: Assets posted by CFM to CBBM may not exceed 120% of the margin required for the relevant customer positions under the stated conditions.
cftc_letter_26_17.payment_stablecoin_condition: After the GENIUS Act effective date, qualifying payment stablecoins must meet the statutory definition and be issued by a permitted or foreign payment stablecoin issuer; do not assume every stablecoin automatically qualifies.
cftc_letter_26_17.actual_xrp_use: NOT_VERIFIED; current Coinbase Prime public collateral list remains USDC, BTC and ETH.

market_interpretation.xrp_utility: Confirmed non-US cross-collateral eligibility and XRP-indexed USDC-settled options increase XRP's institutional collateral and derivatives utility.
market_interpretation.capital_flow: Posting existing XRP as collateral is not a new spot purchase; collateral is encumbered while positions remain open.
market_interpretation.downside_channel: Auto-rebalancing can sell a positive-equity currency such as XRP to cover a negative settlement-currency balance; liquidation and forced rebalancing can create sell pressure.
market_interpretation.circle_link: Circle-issued USDC is the settlement/debt currency in these products. This creates an indirect XRP-USDC financial-market linkage; it does not prove Circle directly lends or buys XRP.
market_interpretation.regional_split: Non-US Global Derivatives publicly lists XRP as cross collateral. US Prime public collateral documentation currently lists only USDC, BTC and ETH.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Non-US XRP cross-collateral eligibility increases institutional use and can lock existing XRP outside immediate spot float.
support: Coinbase Help lists XRP as cross-collateral currency
15% standard-margin haircut; any cross-margined derivative position
limits: No posted XRP collateral balances or customer counts disclosed
Collateral can be rebalanced or released

competing_hypotheses.claim: Cross-collateral rebalancing and liquidation can turn XRP into a source of forced settlement liquidity during stress.
support: Coinbase documentation explicitly permits rebalancing from positive to negative settlement currency
Negative equity incurs daily collateral fee
limits: No XRP-specific rebalancing or liquidation volumes disclosed

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC becomes the common settlement asset linking XRP derivatives and collateral to Circle's stablecoin ecosystem.
support: XRP options index XRP_USDC and settle in USDC
XRP can collateralize cross-margined products settled in another currency
limits: USDC issuer does not directly operate Coinbase/Deribit matching or margin engines

competing_hypotheses.claim: The US CFTC pathway may eventually permit XRP collateral for CFM/Deribit 30.7 customers, but it is not yet demonstrated in current product documentation.
support: CFTC Letter 26-17 includes customer-owned digital commodities and references XRP in the digital-commodity interpretation
disconfirming: Coinbase Prime current eligible-collateral list is USDC, BTC and ETH only
